weeks.prompt: Will the S&P 500 index close above 8,000 within the next 42 days?
Will the S&P 500 index close above 7,500 within the next 42 days?
Will the price of Bitcoin exceed $75,000 within the next 42 days?
weeks.resolution_notes: Affirmative. Bitcoin broke $75,000 on Aug 20, 2026, reaching $75,400+ during a $3B short squeeze triggered by U.S. Treasury bond buybacks. First time above that level since late May. CoinDesk and multiple exchanges confirmed the move.

weeks.prompt: Will any presidential candidate win outright in the first round of the Brazil election within the next 42 days?
weeks.resolution_notes: Negative. Brazil's first round is scheduled for Oct 4, 2026 — well after the Aug 21 resolve date. No election occurred by the contract deadline. Polling shows Lula (39%) vs Flávio Bolsonaro (33%) with no candidate near the 50%+ threshold for first-round victory.

weeks.prompt: Will the U.S. Senate be controlled by the Democratic Party within the next 42 days?
weeks.resolution_notes: Negative. Republicans maintained their 53-47 Senate majority (with 2 independents caucusing with Democrats). No midterm election occurred by the resolve date — the 2026 elections are Nov 3. Senate control remained unchanged from the 2024 result.

weeks.prompt: Will Ukraine hold national elections for the parliament and/or presidency between February 12 and December 31, 2025?
weeks.resolution_notes: Negative. Ukraine did not hold national elections in 2025. Martial law — in effect since Feb 2022 — prohibits elections under the Ukrainian constitution. The Rada extended martial law multiple times through 2025 and into 2026 (currently through Oct 31, 2026). A Feb 2025 resolution reaffirmed elections would wait for 'sustainable peace.'

weeks.prompt: Will any country leave NATO within the next 42 days?
weeks.resolution_notes: Negative. No NATO member filed an Article 13 notice of denunciation by the resolve date. While Trump threatened U.S. withdrawal over NATO allies' stance on Iran, the 2023 Kaine-Rubio legislation requires a two-thirds Senate supermajority for any U.S. exit. No country has ever formally left NATO since 1949.

weeks.prompt: Will any presidential candidate win outright in the first round of the Colombia's election by Jun 12, 2026?
weeks.resolution_notes: Negative. Colombia's first round on May 31, 2026 produced no outright winner. Abelardo de la Espriella led with 43.74% and Iván Cepeda followed at 40.90% — neither crossed the 50%+ threshold. A runoff was held June 21 (after the contract deadline), won by de la Espriella with 49.66%.
